text:
Asha: Heads-up — ACME private pilot needs cross-team signoff on launch gates. Customer asks: private VPC + HSM, prewarm, predictable latency. Proposed canary Wed 2024-04-10. Need to confirm resource and security checklist. @Jon @Priya @Luca @Devon @Ken :eyes:
Jon: Quick Q — which model artifact + seq len dist? quantized variant or full fp16 for canary? Need to run perf matrix.
Asha: They prefer quantized if quality within 1% BLEU-like metric. I'll drop artifacts to S3 by EOD.
Jon: Great. Plan: run 3x perf runs (kv-cache cold/warm, batch profiles). Need 2 GPUs for ~72h. Can also validate continuous batching thresholds.
Priya: Infra note — VPC peering + KMS/HSM provisioning needs TF change and infra review. Estimate 4 dev days for staging infra + 2 days for smoke. Need PR + runbook.
Luca: Security check — HSM attestation + KMS key policies are blockers until we complete a scoped threat model. Also need to validate key rotation flow. Can do review in parallel but need access to deployment plan.
Marta: From Product: customer will accept a canary only if p95 < 200ms and no security items marked as "blocker". They want token-level cost visibility and the post-canary retro.
Devon: Prewarm thoughts — we can shard prewarm across reserved nodes. I can allocate burst capacity from the reserved pool but we need 24h notice before canary. Also require a prewarm script and an automated heat check: `curl /health/kv_cache` -> expect `ready`.
Ken: I'll own the customer-facing runbook and acceptance tests. Will produce the prompt set + eval harness. Request sample traffic: ~10k tokens/hour from their sandbox traffic generator.
Jon: Also recommend a graceful fallback: route 10% -> hosted variant if runtime regressions appear. Suggest rollout policy `5% -> 20% -> 100%` over 6h windows with canary SLO checks at each step.
Asha: Acceptance checklist (first pass):
```
- infra: VPC + KMS/HSM provisioned and smoke-passed
- runtime: quantized model validated (quality delta <1%) and KV cache warm
- perf: p95 < 200ms on canary traffic profile
- obs: token-level cost + latency dashboards + alerting
- security: scoped threat model + key rotation validated
- runbook: customer acceptance tests + rollback steps
```
Priya: Will add TF PR link + infra smoke checklist. Target to finish infra changes by Tue EOD.
Luca: I'll run the quick threat model and list any must-fix blockers by Tue as well. If HSM attestation requires vendor windows, flagging that now.
Devon: I'll supply the prewarm script and an automated check. Can schedule prewarm 24h before canary.
Marta: Customer confirmed they'll tolerate the fallback plan. Also asked for a short SLA note for the pilot — I'll draft.
Jon: One more ask — provide representative token length histogram. That affects batching decisions.
Asha: I'll upload the histogram + model artifacts today.
Ken: After runbook is ready I'll coordinate a dry-run with the customer next Tue.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued for 2024-04-10T03:00:00Z (waiting on manual approve).
Asha: Next steps: Priya, Jon, Luca sign off on PRs by EOD Fri. If all clear, runbook dry-run Tue, prewarm Wed-24h, canary Wed. :thumbsup:
